card.summary: The Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026 reauthorizes, modifies, and funds a wide variety of United States Department of Agriculture programs across twelve titles through fiscal year 2031. It adjusts commodity programs, conservation efforts, nutrition assistance like SNAP, agricultural trade, credit and loan limits, rural development, forestry, energy initiatives, horticulture, crop insurance, animal health, and foreign agricultural land ownership reporting.
